title: DEV/BETA URGENT !!! Don't stop closed loop  !!!
symptom: In the middle of the night, the engineering mode stopped (likely because a new dev version was available), causing the closed loop to stop and the user to wake up with a hypo alert. The engineering file was deleted, and AAPS reverted to open loop.
cause: The engineering file was deleted, likely by Android maintenance or a cleaning app, not by AAPS itself. AAPS does not delete this file itself.
fix: The user added text to the engineering file to make it non-empty, hoping it would not be deleted. No official fix was provided.
evidence_quote: AAPS doesn't delete this file itself
